criteria.name: Scarcity
criteria.definition: How much can total supply grow, and who decides? Higher = supply growth is lower and harder to change.

criteria.name: Verifiability
criteria.definition: Can a holder check authenticity and total supply on their own, without trusting a third party?

criteria.name: Counterparty risk
criteria.definition: Is the asset someone else's liability, or does it depend on an operator, issuer or custodian to keep its value? Higher = less dependence.

criteria.name: Durability
criteria.definition: Does the asset persist over time without decay, upkeep or an external system to keep it alive?

criteria.name: Portability
criteria.definition: How easily can the holder move it across distance and borders?

criteria.name: Censorship resistance
criteria.definition: How hard is it for a third party (including a state) to block, freeze or seize it?

criteria.name: Settlement finality
criteria.definition: Once transferred, how quickly and firmly is the transfer irreversible?

criteria.name: Debasement risk
criteria.definition: How exposed is the holder to dilution of supply or loss of purchasing power by design? Higher = less exposed.

cells.label: Very strong
cells.rationale: Consensus code caps issuance: subsidy halves every 210,000 blocks; total converges on 20,999,999.9769 BTC.

cells.label: Strong
cells.rationale: Supply grows only by mining: about 3,300 t mined in 2025 (USGS) against about 222,600 t ever mined (WGC), roughly 1.5% a year; WGC's own 10-year average is about 1.8%.

cells.label: Mixed
cells.rationale: New rooms can always be built. Public outlooks put U.S. supply growth at 0.7% CAGR over three years (CBRE) to 2.3% in 2026 (PwC).

cells.label: Weak
cells.rationale: Issued at the Treasury's discretion to fund the government; total debt outstanding is published daily and has no fixed cap.

cells.label: Very weak
cells.rationale: M2 grew from $286.6B (Jan 1959) to $23,342.8B (Aug 2026), about 81x.

cells.label: Very strong
cells.rationale: Any user running a full node checks every block against the rules, including the supply limit, without trusting miners.

cells.label: Mixed
cells.rationale: Purity and weight need assay. The London market relies on accredited refiners and a bar specification (Good Delivery).

cells.label: Weak
cells.rationale: Title is recorded, but value is an estimate: the issuer's fair-value tests rest on 'subjective assumptions' such as discount and terminal cap rates.

cells.label: Strong
cells.rationale: Outstanding debt is published daily and holdings are book-entry records, but holders rely on the record-keeper rather than checking independently.

cells.label: Mixed
cells.rationale: Money stock is published monthly, but holders cannot independently audit money creation.

cells.label: Strong
cells.rationale: Self-custodied bitcoin is nobody's liability. Held on an exchange it carries the full counterparty risk: see the FTX fraud charges (SEC, 2022).

cells.label: Strong
cells.rationale: Bullion held directly is nobody's liability. Vaulted or pooled gold adds custodian dependence.

cells.label: Weak
cells.rationale: Value depends on third-party managers, brands, lenders and ground lessors. All of the issuer's hotels are run by third-party managers.

cells.label: Strong
cells.rationale: A direct obligation of the U.S. Treasury, the market's reference credit, but still a promise from an issuer.

cells.label: Mixed
cells.rationale: Bank deposits are bank liabilities, insured to at least $250,000 per depositor per bank. Cash is a central-bank liability.

cells.label: Mixed
cells.rationale: No physical decay, but it persists only while the network runs. Under 18 years of history since the genesis block; mining uses an estimated 0.6–2.3% of U.S. electricity (EIA).

cells.label: Very strong
cells.rationale: Virtually indestructible: almost all gold ever mined still exists.

cells.label: Weak
cells.rationale: Buildings depreciate over 5–40 years and FF&E over 3–12 years. Owners fund FF&E reserves of 3.0–5.5% of hotel revenue.

cells.label: Strong
cells.rationale: Book-entry claims don't decay, but each bill matures within 4–52 weeks and must be rolled over.

cells.label: Mixed
cells.rationale: Notes wear out (Fed estimate for a $1 note: 7.2 years); balances depend on the banking system.

cells.label: Very strong
cells.rationale: Control is a key that can be written as a 12- to 24-word phrase and carried across any border.

cells.label: Weak
cells.rationale: Physical: an institutional bar weighs roughly 400 troy oz and needs secure transport and insurance.

cells.label: Very weak
cells.rationale: Immovable. The issuer flags real estate illiquidity and the lack of alternative uses for hotels.

cells.label: Mixed
cells.rationale: Transferable within the regulated custody chain (Fedwire Securities), not outside it.

cells.label: Strong
cells.rationale: Moves electronically within the banking system. Carrying more than $10,000 in or out of the U.S. must be reported.

cells.label: Strong
cells.rationale: Self-custody transfers need no permission, but access points are regulated: OFAC lists addresses on the SDN list, and China declared all crypto transactions illegal in 2021.

cells.label: Weak
cells.rationale: Physical gold can be seized or its holding prohibited: the 1933 U.S. order required delivery of gold to the Federal Reserve.

cells.label: Very weak
cells.rationale: Fixed in a jurisdiction: subject to eminent domain, including for economic development (Kelo, 2005), and to property tax.

cells.label: Very weak
cells.rationale: Freezable at the custodian: Treasury immobilized the Russian central bank's U.S.-held assets in 2022.

cells.label: Weak
cells.rationale: Accounts can be blocked under sanctions programs. Cash moves hand to hand but is reportable above $10,000 at the border.

cells.label: Strong
cells.rationale: Probabilistic: each new block (10-minute target) makes reversal exponentially less likely. No chargebacks.

cells.label: Mixed
cells.rationale: Physical delivery is final but slow. Bar-for-bar settlement depends on a standard specification.

cells.label: Very weak
cells.rationale: Sales are subject to contingencies and closings can fail or take months.

cells.label: Very strong
cells.rationale: Delivery-versus-payment on Fedwire Securities, with final payment in Federal Reserve master accounts (during operating hours).

cells.label: Mixed
cells.rationale: Fedwire payments are final, but consumer electronic transfers carry error-resolution rights (Regulation E).

cells.label: Very strong
cells.rationale: Issuance is fixed in code: currently 3.125 BTC per block (about 0.8% a year at target spacing), halving again at block 1,050,000.

cells.label: Strong
cells.rationale: Mining adds roughly 1.5–1.8% a year to the above-ground stock (USGS-based estimate; WGC 10-year average).

cells.label: Mixed
cells.rationale: Room rates reprice nightly, but wages, property taxes and insurance also rise with inflation, per the issuer's 10-K.

cells.label: Weak
cells.rationale: Nominal. Using fed funds as a proxy, the yield sat below CPI inflation in 192 of 320 months since 2000 (June 2022: CPI +9.0% vs 1.21%).

cells.label: Very weak
cells.rationale: The Fed targets 2% inflation over the longer run. The dollar has lost 87.9% of its purchasing power since August 1971 (CPI).

btc_weak_spots.label: Short history
btc_weak_spots.detail: Genesis block: 2009-01-03, under 18 years of data. Statistical claims carry that caveat.

btc_weak_spots.label: Exchange / custody risk
btc_weak_spots.detail: Coins held on a platform are a claim on that platform (FTX, 2022).

btc_weak_spots.label: Regulatory risk
btc_weak_spots.detail: States can outlaw on-ramps (China, 2021) and sanction addresses (OFAC).

btc_weak_spots.label: Energy dependence
btc_weak_spots.detail: Mining uses an estimated 0.6–2.3% of U.S. electricity (EIA preliminary estimate).

btc_weak_spots.label: Software risk
btc_weak_spots.detail: A 2010 bug briefly created about 184 billion BTC before a software fix (value overflow incident).
